name: GistMag Alt Text Generator
author: gistmag

sections.description:
GistMag Alt Text Generator helps you automatically generate high-quality alternative text for images in your WordPress media library.

It uses the GistMag API to create descriptive, SEO-friendly alt text that improves accessibility for screen readers and helps search engines better understand your images.

Key features:

  • Auto-generate alt text on image upload
  • Generate alt text manually for individual images
  • Bulk alt text generation for existing media library images
  • Multiple modes: Short, Long, and SEO-optimized alt text
  • Works in the Media Library list and grid views
  • Usage statistics so you can track how many images you’ve processed

You will need a free GistMag account and API key to use this plugin.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install it through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to GistMag ATG in the WordPress admin sidebar to enter your API key and configure settings.
sections.faq:
Do I need an API key?

Yes. You can create a free GistMag account and get your API key from the GistMag dashboard.

Will this overwrite existing alt text?

By default, the plugin will not overwrite existing alt text unless you explicitly run the bulk generator or manual generator on those images.

Does this store my images?

Images are processed securely by the GistMag API to generate alt text. They are not stored permanently; they are only used for the purpose of generating descriptions.

Does this work with WooCommerce?

Yes. The plugin works with any images in your Media Library, including product images used by WooCommerce.
